from itertools import combinations, permutations
import z3, time
n=17
edge_index={}
edges=[]
idx=1
for i in range(n):
 for j in range(i+1,n):
  edge_index[(i,j)]=idx; edges.append((i,j)); idx+=1
X=[z3.Bool(f'e_{i}_{j}') for i,j in edges]
def x(i,j):
 if i>j: i,j=j,i
 return X[edge_index[(i,j)]-1]
# enumerate cycles canonical
cycles=[]
for k in range(3,7):
 seen=set()
 for cyc in permutations(range(n),k):
  # canonical: min vertex first, second < last to break direction
  if cyc[0]!=min(cyc): continue
  if cyc[1]>cyc[-1]: continue
  key=cyc
  # all distinct by permutations
  seen.add(key)
 for cyc in seen:
  cycles.append(cyc)
print('cycles', len(cycles), {k:sum(1 for c in cycles if len(c)==k) for k in range(3,7)})
s=z3.Solver()
# no cycles
for cyc in cycles:
 s.add(z3.Not(z3.And([x(cyc[i],cyc[(i+1)%len(cyc)]) for i in range(len(cyc))])))
# at least 30
s.add(z3.PbGe([(v,1) for v in X],30))
# optional color 4
colors=[z3.Int(f'c{i}') for i in range(n)]
for c in colors: s.add(c>=0,c<4)
for m,(i,j) in enumerate(edges):
 s.add(z3.Implies(X[m], colors[i]!=colors[j]))
print('constraints added', len(s.assertions()))
s.set('timeout', 60000)
t=time.time(); res=s.check(); print('res',res,'time',time.time()-t)
if res==z3.sat:
 model=s.model()
 sol=[e for v,e in zip(X,edges) if model.eval(v, model_completion=True)]
 print(len(sol), sol)
 print([model.eval(c) for c in colors])

from itertools import combinations, permutations
from pysat.solvers import Cadical153, Glucose3, Minisat22
from pysat.card import CardEnc, EncType
import time
n=17
edges=[]; var={}
for i in range(n):
 for j in range(i+1,n):
  var[(i,j)]=len(edges)+1; edges.append((i,j))
def evar(i,j):
 if i>j: i,j=j,i
 return var[(i,j)]
clauses=[]
counts={}
for k in range(3,7):
 cnt=0
 for cyc in permutations(range(n),k):
  if cyc[0]!=min(cyc): continue
  if cyc[1]>cyc[-1]: continue
  clauses.append([-evar(cyc[i],cyc[(i+1)%k]) for i in range(k)])
  cnt+=1
 counts[k]=cnt
print('cycle clauses',len(clauses), counts)
# at least 30 edges
card=CardEnc.atleast(lits=list(range(1,len(edges)+1)), bound=30, encoding=EncType.seqcounter)
clauses2=clauses+card.clauses
print('vars', card.nv, 'clauses', len(clauses2))
for Solver in [Cadical153, Glucose3, Minisat22]:
 print('solver', Solver)
 s=Solver(bootstrap_with=clauses2)
 t=time.time(); res=s.solve(); print('res',res,'time',time.time()-t)
 if res:
  model=set(l for l in s.get_model() if l>0)
  sol=[edge for i,edge in enumerate(edges, start=1) if i in model]
  print('m',len(sol), sol)
  raise SystemExit
